title: Sales Development Representative - All levels (f,m,x)
description: Wir suchen eine:n SDR für unser Growth Team an unserem Standort in Berlin oder Hamburg. Werde Teil unseres Teams und baue mit uns das größte KI-gestützte FinTech für das Gesundheitswesen auf! Das Level für diese Rolle legen wir gemeinsam im Prozess fest – abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und wie du im Interview überzeugst. Über Nelly Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann. Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben. Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um. Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung. KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist. Deine Rolle bei uns: Du bist die erste Stimme, die potenzielle Nelly-Kund:innen von uns hören – und die Person, die entscheidet, welche Leads es bis zur Demo schaffen. Konkret heißt das: Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf: von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum gebuchten Demo-Termin, komplett eigenverantwortlich. Du sprichst täglich mit ca. 60 potenziellen Kund:innen – am Telefon, per Cold Call und im Inbound-Gespräch – und entscheidest selbst, wie du sie überzeugst. Du qualifizierst Leads sauber und ordnest sie korrekt bestehenden Accounts zu, damit im Vertriebsteam niemand bei null anfängt. Du gibst Marketing direktes Feedback zur Lead-Qualität – deine Beobachtungen fließen sofort in die nächste Kampagne ein. Du bist Teil von Messen und Events und bekommst dadurch Einblick, wie Nelly bei echten Kund:innen ankommt – nicht nur am Telefon. Du arbeitest eng mit Partnerships und Marketing zusammen und siehst, wie dein Beitrag den gesamten Sales-Zyklus verkürzt Das bringst du mit: Du hast Hunter-Mentalität und Can-do-Attitude – Telefonieren und Überzeugen ist für dich kein notwendiges Übel, sondern macht dir Spaß. Du übernimmst Ownership über deine eigene Pipeline, ohne dass dir jemand hinterherlaufen muss. Du bist stressresistent und KPI-getrieben – Zahlen motivieren dich, sie schüchtern dich nicht ein. Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn: Du lieber in Ruhe an einer Sache feilst, statt täglich viele Calls zu führen und dich an klaren Zahlen messen zu lassen. description: Die Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt sucht IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Termin in Berlin (hoher Homeoffice-Anteil möglich) mit 35 Wochenstunden (Vollzeit) in Festanstellung. Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der kein Tier mehr für die Herstellung von Lebensmitteln leidet. Unsere Mission lautet: Gemeinsam Tierschutzstandards erhöhen und den Verbrauch von Tierprodukten senken. Mit unserer Arbeit wirken wir in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Recht und Politik. Auf allen Ebenen gehen wir mit den jeweiligen Akteur:innen praktikable Schritte in Richtung eines respektvollen Umgangs mit den Tieren und erleichtern auch vermeintlichen Gegner:innen den Ausstieg aus bisherigen Handlungsmustern. Als IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering wirst du Teil unseres bislang zweiköpfigen IT-Teams, das mit einem reibungslosen, effizienten und sicheren Betrieb von IT-Infrastruktur und Online-Auftritten dafür sorgt, dass unsere Arbeit ihre maximale Wirkung entfalten kann. Das bewirkst du bei uns Du legst das technische Fundament, auf dem die gesamte Arbeit der Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt aufbaut, und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig, sicher und zukunftsfähig bleiben. Als IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering bist du verantwortlich für die Konzeption, Planung und Umsetzung der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur und -Anwendungslandschaft: Du betreust unsere Hosting-Infrastruktur in der Cloud und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, sorgst dafür, dass zentrale Systeme wie CRM, Spendenplattform, Webseiten, Kampagnen und Mailing-Infrastruktur reibungslos miteinander Daten austauschen, und entwickelst dafür auch individuelle Softwarelösungen. Im Einzelnen bedeutet das Du betreust, entwickelst und integrierst sowohl unsere bestehenden als auch neu einzuführende IT-Systeme, wie auch unsere DevOps-Plattform, zum Beispiel GitHub und AWS, weiter. Du konzipierst, implementierst, dokumentierst und rollst neue IT-Projekte & Lösungen aus. Du stehst im engen Austausch mit Kolleg:innen im IT-Team und in anderen Fachbereichen und berätst zu fachlichen wie nicht-fachlichen Anforderungen, etwa IT-Sicherheit oder Usability. Du unterstützt und berätst die Fachbereiche bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von IT-Lösungen – von der Einschätzung technischer Machbarkeit und Aufwand über die technische Umsetzung bis hin zur Auswahl geeigneter Off-the-Shelf-Komponenten. Dein Profil Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie im Betrieb moderner Anwendungs- und Plattform-Infrastrukturen (z. B. Cloud/PaaS, CI/CD, Integrationen). Im Bereich DevOps und IT-Infrastruktur bringst du herausragende Erfahrung mit. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung (vorzugsweise PHP/Laravel) und der Integration von Anwendungen per REST oder GraphQL APIs Für die Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen beherrschst du HTML, (S)CSS und Javascript/Typescript und hast auch Erfahrung in der Anpassung von PHP-basierten CMS-Systemen wie Kirby und Statamic. Du bist in der Lage, ein IT-Projekt von Anfang bis Ende zu planen, durchzuführen und zu Ende zu bringen. Dabei arbeitest du zusammen mit fachlichen Stakeholdern, von der Anforderungsanalyse über iterative Checkpoints bis zum Rollout . Du nutzt KI-Systeme, um deine eigene Arbeit zu unterstützen, und kannst anderen dabei helfen, KI für ihre Ziele sinnvoll einzusetzen. Gute Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung von Arbeitsabläufen sind gefragt, mit KI-Tooling, Low-Code/No-Code-Plattformen oder klassisch per Scripting. Du hast gute Kenntnisse in IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz. Du kennst dich aus im Bereich Identitätsmanagement (IAM) per OAuth oder SAML. Du bist team- und kommunikationsfähig und arbeitest serviceorientiert sowie selbständig. Mit deiner herausragenden Problemlösungskompetenz gehst du auch komplexe technische Herausforderungen sicher an. Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weil z. B. eine Deadline näher rückt, bleibst du konzentriert. Deutsch und Englisch sprichst du verhandlungssicher (C1-Niveau). Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen – auch wenn nicht alle an einem Ort sind. Du identifizierst dich mit unserer Vision, Mission und Kultur . Was wir dir bieten Eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Stelle auf 35-Basis: Als Teil des IT-Teams bewirkst du direkt gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und verbesserst den Tierschutz. Home-Office-Möglichkeiten: Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und arbeitest mit flexiblen, familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten im hybriden Modell (Homeoffice & Büro). Professionelles Team: Kollegialer, offener Austausch in einem motivierten Team Hundefreundliche Büros inkl. „hundefreie“ Bereiche für Allergiker:innen sowie ergonomische Arbeitsplätze Attraktive Vergütung: Unbefristet, Jahresgehalt zwischen 48.940,20 und 59.243,40 Euro (erfahrungsbasiert) + Bonuszahlungen Benefits: Cafeteria-Modell (finanzielle Vorteile, Deutschlandticket oder zusätzliche Urlaubstage), Zuschüsse zu Gesundheitsleistungen (z. B. B12 + D Bluttests) und betriebliche Altersvorsorge Weiterbildung: Aktive Förderung von Fort- und Weiterbildungen Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung bis zum 31.10.2026 per Bewerbungsbutton. Wir möchten von dir erfahren, was dich motiviert, bei der Albert Schweitzer Stiftung zu arbeiten, weshalb du die beste Person für diese Rolle bist und wann du bei uns anfangen könntest. Solltest du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, ermutigen wir dich trotzdem, dich zu bewerben - wir sind auf der Suche nach einer lernfähigen und motivierten Person, die in unser Team passt. Wir sind überzeugt, dass vielfältige Perspektiven Entscheidungen verbessern können und begrüßen daher ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen verschiedener Hintergründe. Bei Fragen zu der Stelle melde dich gerne bei Marie Mittermeier an . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Deine Aufgaben Die Eberhardt Service Group steht für modernes, nachhaltiges Facility Management und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Leistungen. Digitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz und die intelligente Nutzung von Daten eröffnen dabei enorme Chancen: Prozesse können einfacher werden, Mitarbeitende entlastet, Entscheidungen besser getroffen und unsere Leistungen für Kunden weiterentwickelt werden. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die AI & Data nicht nur strategisch denkt, sondern ins Unternehmen bringt und messbare Wirkung erzeugt. Als Head of AI & Data (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von AI, Data und digitalen Lösungen innerhalb der Eberhardt Service Group. Du verbindest Unternehmensstrategie, operative Prozesse und Technologie und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die AI- und Data-Strategie der Eberhardt Service Group und übersetzt sie in eine klare Roadmap und konkrete Maßnahmen. Du analysierst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Potenziale für AI, Daten, Digitalisierung und Automatisierung . Du bewertest, priorisierst und steuerst AI- und Data-Initiativen nach Nutzen, Aufwand, Risiko, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Skalierbarkeit – von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Du verantwortest die Entwicklung und Implementierung von AI-Anwendungen, Automatisierungen, digitalen Tools und datenbasierten Lösungen und entscheidest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern, was wir selbst entwickeln, einkaufen oder integrieren. Du baust die notwendigen Datenstrukturen, Governance und Standards für einen sicheren, verantwortungsvollen und skalierbaren Einsatz von AI und Daten auf und berücksichtigst dabei Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und regulatorische Anforderungen. Du machst den Nutzen von AI und Data messbar, entwickelst Business Cases und KPIs und stellst sicher, dass erfolgreiche Lösungen einen konkreten Beitrag zu Effizienz, Qualität, Produktivität und Unternehmensentwicklung leisten. Du führst und entwickelst das AI-&-Data-Team, baust die entsprechenden Kompetenzen im Unternehmen weiter aus und arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Führungskräften und Fachbereichen zusammen. Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science, AI oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – alternativ eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in AI, Data, Digitalisierung, Automatisierung oder Technologie. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von AI-/Data-Strategien und konkreten Use Cases. Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams und/oder größeren Projekten sowie in der Verantwortung für Budgets und Ressourcen. Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, digitale, AI- oder Data-Lösungen aufzubauen, einzuführen und zu skalieren. Verständnis für Claude, Python, Generative AI, LLMs, AI-Agenten und Automatisierung. Gute Kenntnisse in Data Governance , Datenplattformen, Analytics und Datenqualität. Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Systemen wie SAP BO oder ELO. Erfahrung mit Cloud- und AI-Plattformen, idealerweise im Microsoft-Umfeld Verständnis für den gesamten AI-Lifecycle – von der Idee über Piloten bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Erfahrung mit Business Cases, ROI-Betrachtungen und der wirtschaftlichen Bewertung von Technologie. Grundlegendes Verständnis moderner IT- und Microsoft-Umgebungen. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst mit der Geschäftsführung über Strategie und Investitionen sprechen, mit operativen Führungskräften über Prozesse und mit technischen Spezialisten über Architektur, Daten und AI. Erfahrung in Change-Management und im Aufbau von AI-/Data-Kompetenzen in Fachbereichen, die neu mit diesen Themen in Berührung kommen. description: <h2 class="sc-1npqnwg-4 sc-1npqnwg-5 sc-1uwf3m5-0 ghXWGq custom-css-style-job-description">Job description</h2> <p><strong>Team &amp; Reporting Line:</strong> Imaging Operations&nbsp;</p> <p class="Paragraph SCXW53634494 BCX8"><span style="color: rgb(61, 116, 204);"><strong>Our Mission</strong>&nbsp;</span></p> <p class="Paragraph SCXW53634494 BCX8"></p> <p>At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth - where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.</p> <p>From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(61, 116, 204);"><strong>Your Role</strong></span></p> <p>As part of the constellr Imaging Operations team, you will build, maintain, and operationalize our onboard payload software — carrying the payload from commissioning through to day-to-day in-orbit operations across the satellite's full lifecycle.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, high-impact role focused on turning flight software into reliable, operational reality. You will be involved in the design and contribute operational feedback that helps shape it, you will drive the operationalization of in orbit payload software, supporting operations, anomaly solving and commissioning on each new satellite.</p> <p>You'll collaborate closely across the business — working day-to-day with internal engineering teams, Product Assurance, Project Management, and Operations, as well as external suppliers — and you'll operate at a high interface with the hardware and operations teams, ensuring the software runs reliably on the payload hardware.</p> <p>Your work will directly influence the reliability, performance, and long-term success of constellr's mission, helping turn mission concepts into robust, flight-ready, operational software systems.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(61, 116, 204);"><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Develop, test, and maintain high-reliability onboard payload software, with a focus on making it operational <li>Support in-orbit operations and the operations team, ensuring the onboard software performs reliably in flight.</li> <li>Provide operational feedback into software requirements and design across onboard systems.</li> <li>Work at a high interface with the hardware team to make the software operational on&nbsp;the payload hardware.</li> <li>Support the delivery of new software features and upgrades, working closely with external suppliers and development partners.</li> <li>Support verification and validation activities for onboard systems and flight software, from laboratory testing through to in-orbit performance.</li> <li>Contribute to integration and testing activities using Flatsat environments and other ground-based simulation and validation platforms.</li> <li>Support the We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working.

manufacturers worldwide.</p> <p>As we prepare for significant growth over the next 6-12 months, we're building a network of talented Software Engineers across a range of experience levels, from early-career engineers through to Principal Engineers.</p> <p>We'd love to hear from exceptional engineers who would like to be considered as future opportunities become available.</p> <p><strong>Why Infinitesima?</strong></p> <p>Based in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, Infinitesima develops advanced semiconductor metrology technology that is helping enable the next generation of electronics manufacturing.</p> <p>Our technology combines cutting-edge software, precision mechanics, motion control and nanoscale measurement science to solve some of the most challenging problems in semiconductor inspection.</p> <p>We're a growing team of more than 150 scientists, engineers and business professionals, backed by world-class investors including Applied Ventures, the venture capital arm of Applied Materials, one of the global leaders in semiconductor equipment.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to register your interest with a company where software engineering directly influences the performance of highly advanced scientific and industrial systems.</p> <p><strong>Technologies and Skills We're Actively Interested In</strong></p> <p>We're particularly keen to connect with description: <div> <h2>Field Service Engineer | Advanced Semiconductor Metrology Systems</h2> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Abingdon, Oxfordshire, with up to <strong>20&nbsp;percent international trave</strong>l<br><strong>Salary:</strong> £40,000 to £46,000 + EMI Share Options + Private Healthcare</p> <p>If you’re the kind of engineer who enjoys solving difficult technical problems in front of real customers, this could be a seriously strong move.</p> <p>Infinitesima designs advanced metrology systems used by semiconductor customers around the world. You’ll be installing, commissioning, maintaining, upgrading and troubleshooting complex systems at customer sites worldwide. These are not simple plug-and-play products. You’ll be working across electromechanical systems, optics, software-controlled platforms and precision instrumentation, often where uptime really matters.</p> <p>You’ll suit this role if you’re calm under pressure, technically curious, and good at explaining complex issues clearly to customers. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="color: rgb(101, 101, 101);"><span data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"> roads </span><span data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(101, 101, 101);" data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)">Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(65, 145, 76);" data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)">Job description</span></h2></div><h4>About the Team</h4> <p>At Castrol, we don’t just make fluids, we help define the future of mobility, energy and digital infrastructure. The Advanced Electrification Testing (AET) team sits within Castrol’s Technology organisation and plays a critical role in supporting Research &amp; Product Development by generating real-world performance data on lubricants, thermal management fluids and cooling technologies. Our mission is to understand how liquids perform inside the systems they are designed to protect and optimise, from electric vehicle batteries and ultra-fast chargers to high-performance data centres and advanced electronics.<br>As part of a major investment programme, Castrol’s Pangbourne Technology Centre is evolving into a centre of excellence for electrification and energy technologies. The team operates world-class testing facilities including battery cell, module and pack laboratories, high-voltage charging systems, immersion cooling tanks, data centre server environments and large-scale thermal management test rigs.<br>This is a team for engineers who are naturally curious. You'll work in an environment that combines the freedom of university-style research with the pace and impact of commercial product development. One day you may be investigating battery cooling performance, the next developing new testing methodologies for data centre technologies or semiconductor cooling systems.<br>You'll join a highly collaborative group of engineers, technicians, graduates and researchers who are passionate about solving complex engineering challenges. We are looking for individuals who love understanding how things work, enjoy getting hands-on with equipment, and want to help create the next generation of high-performance technologies.</p> <h4>Key Tasks</h4> <p>As a Senior Engineer, you will lead research and development testing projects from concept through to final technical recommendations, working closely with internal stakeholders, technology experts and external partners.<br><br>Key responsibilities include:<br><br>- Leading end-to-end testing and engineering projects supporting Castrol's research and product development programmes.<br>- Designing, building, commissioning and operating advanced test rigs and experimental systems.<br>- Developing innovative testing methodologies for emerging technologies across electric vehicles, batteries, charging infrastructure and data centres.<br>- Designing experiments using statistical Design of Experiments (DoE) techniques and ensuring data quality and repeatability.<br>- Performing advanced data analysis and translating results into meaningful engineering insights and recommendations.<br>- Working hands-on with high-voltage systems, instrumentation, thermal management equipment and power electronics.<br>- Supporting the installation, operation and continuous improvement of testing facilities and equipment.<br>- Acting as a subject matter expert in one or more areas such as battery systems, thermal management, data centres, cooling technologies, power electronics or DC power systems.<br>-&nbsp;Collaborating with OEMs, technology partners and internal stakeholders to deliver co-engineered solutions.<br>- Coaching and mentoring engineers, technicians, graduates and interns while acting as a technical role model within the team.<br>- Identifying new technologies, testing opportunities and research directions that strengthen Castrol's innovation capability.<br>- Representing Castrol externally through technical engagement with customers, industry partners and research organisations.<br>- Maintaining the highest standards of safety, operational excellence and engineering integrity across all activities.</p> <h4>Experience Required</h4> <p>We're looking for an experienced, hands-on engineer with a passion for experimentation, problem-solving and developing new technologies.<br><br>You will typically bring:<br><br>- Degree-qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics or a related engineering discipline.<br>- 5+ years' experience in a professional engineering environment or equivalent in academia.<br>- A strong background in engineering testing, experimental design and data-driven problem solving.<br>- Experience designing, building or operating complex test equipment and test rigs.<br>- Exposure to safety-critical or operational engineering environments.<br>- Knowledge of high-voltage electrical systems (typically &gt;60V DC) and safe working practices.<br>- Strong technical reporting, communication and stakeholder management skills.<br>- The ability to work autonomously while leading projects and influencing technical direction.<br>- A curiosity-driven mindset and a genuine passion for engineering and technology.<br><br>Expertise in at least one of the following areas:<br>- Electric vehicle propulsion systems<br>- Battery technologies<br>- Thermal management and cooling systems<br>- Data centre technologies<br>- DC power systems<br>- Power electronics<br>- Electronics and instrumentation<br><br>Desirable experience includes:</p> <p>- Master's degree, PhD or progression towards Chartered Engineer status.<br>- Experience of battery thermal management, immersion cooling or liquid cooling technologies.<br>- Knowledge of semiconductor or chip cooling applications.<br>- Experience with advanced measurement techniques, data analytics or CAE tools.<br>- Published technical papers or involvement in research programmes.<br>- Experience gained within automotive, battery, aerospace, power, data centre or advanced research environments.</p> <p>This role is ideal for engineers who want more than a traditional testing position. If you're excited by the opportunity to innovate, develop new ideas, work across batteries, data centres, charging systems and emerging technologies, and have access to world-class facilities to turn concepts into reality, we'd love to hear from you.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><span style="color: rgb(65, 145, 76);">Privacy</span></h3> <p><span style="color: rgb(101, 101, 101);">The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. title: Product Manager - Ledger & Reporting
description: <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p>BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.</p> <p>We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.</p> <p><strong>Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.</strong></p> <p>Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.</p> <p>By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.</p> <p>We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.</p> <p>We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:</p> <ul> <li>CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)</li> <li>FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)</li> <li>Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)</li> <li>LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About this role in the team:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Product Manager to own the product vision, strategy, and delivery for the Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation subdomain within BVNK's Ledger domain. You'll&nbsp; work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and commercial teams to define how BVNK's customers&nbsp; and BVNK's own internal teams — see, understand, and trust their financial data.</p> <p>The Ledger domain is the financial backbone of BVNK, a single, trusted source of truth for all customer and transactional balances across products, currencies, and rails. Within this domain, the Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation subdomain is responsible for providing clear, consistent financial views derived from the ledger for both internal and external reporting. Through the Reporting Service, Search Service, and downstream data surfaces,it ensures that positions, balances, and movements are accurately represented for Finance, Risk, Operations, and customers.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, cross-functional role. As part of BVNK's Billing 2.0 vision and the drive toward a 100% self-serve customer experience, you'll define and deliver the product capabilities that give customers full transparency; enabling them to reconcile invoices, audit charges programmatically, and automate close processes, while also building the internal reporting foundations that Finance, Reconciliation, and Operations depend on to scale.</p> <h4><strong>Key Areas of Responsibilities:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own the product vision and roadmap for Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation</strong> — Define the strategy for how BVNK exposes financial data to customers and internal teams, aligning with the broader Ledger domain mission and company objectives (Billing 2.0, self-serve experience, MiCA compliance).</li> <li><strong>Drive transaction report fee breakdowns</strong> — Define requirements and work with engineering to ensure transaction reports and APIs properly include both real-time and invoiced fees, broken down by fee type</li> <li><strong>Build the customer reconciliation product </strong>— Define and deliver customer-facing reconciliation endpoints and reporting surfaces that enable enterprise clients to programmatically audit charges, automate close processes, and reconcile against invoices.</li> <li><strong>Improve internal financial reporting</strong> — Partner with Finance, Reconciliation, and Operations to understand their data needs and deliver standardised reports and views that replace fragmented, manual processes with reliable, automated data pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across domains </strong>— Work with the Billing &amp; Fees, Wallets, Balances , Digital Assets, Treasury, and Reconciliation domain to ensure reporting data is consistent and accurate end-to-end.</li> <li><strong>Define reporting for multi-entity and regulatory requirements</strong> — As BVNK expands across jurisdictions and customer types, ensure reporting structures correctly represent entity-specific data, segregation requirements, and regulatory obligations (MiCA safekeeping, EMI reconciliation).</li> <li><strong>Own stakeholder relationships </strong>— Serve as the primary product contact for Reporting &amp; Customer Reconciliation. Engage regularly with Commercial (AMs/CSMs), Finance, Operations, and enterprise customers to gather requirements, validate solutions, and communicate roadmap priorities.</li> <li><strong>Measure and iterate</strong> — Define and track KPIs for reporting accuracy, customer adoption of reconciliation tools, reduction in manual reconciliation effort, and internal stakeholder satisfaction. title: Junior / Senior Writer
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>JUNIOR/SENIOR WRITERS - REFORM UK</h1> <p>When did you last read something from a political party and actually finish it?</p> <p>Most of it is written by people who have never had to convince anyone of anything.</p> <p>Reform UK reaches tens of millions of people and we do it with words. Very few people in politics can write for that scale. If you can, prove it.&nbsp;</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>Write for every output the party has.</p> <p>Draft directly for the party's most senior figures.</p> <p>Work fast. You will write things that millions of people read, and that our opponents will scrutinise.</p> <h2>Who we're looking for</h2> <p>Ambitious. Hungry. Fast.&nbsp;</p> <p>You do not need a degree. You do not need to have worked in politics. You do not need to have been to the right school or know the right people.</p> <p>What you do need: Excellent writing skills and an understanding of language and copy that appeals to a mass audience.</p> <p>Sharp political instincts and a real feel for what people across Britain actually think, not what Westminster thinks they think. And a genuine belief in what we are doing. This is not a job you can do at arm's length; you must immerse yourself in Reform and our message.</p> <h2>How to apply</h2> <p>Write a 500-word letter, as our Shadow Home Secretary Zia Yusuf, setting out how the political class broke Britain and how Reform UK will fix it. Attach this where you are asked for a cover letter.</p> <p>Send that, plus your CV; examples of your writing and what it achieved.</p> <h2>The details</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Title: Junior/Senior Writer - dependent on experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Pay: competitive, dependent on experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Location: Reform UK HQ, Westminster.</p> </li> <li> <p>Interviews: ASAP</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Data & Analytics Lead
description: <p><strong>Location: </strong>Westminster, London&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Salary:</strong> Competitive&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Reporting to:</strong> Executive Editor&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Reform UK is seeking an exceptional Data &amp; Analytics Lead to build a best-in-class organisation-wide data and insight function from the party's Westminster headquarters. This is a broader opportunity than a conventional web or social analytics role: the successful candidate will help bring together disparate strands of performance, audience, membership, campaign and operational information into a coherent decision-making system.</p> <p>The Data &amp; Analytics Lead will establish the data stack, reporting definitions, access, dashboards and analytical rhythms that allow senior leaders and teams across Reform UK to see what is happening, understand why and act quickly. Digital channels will be an important part of the role, but the aim is to create a shared source of decision-ready insight across the organisation wherever useful data exists.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build the organisation-wide data and insight function</li> <li>Map the major data sources, owners, definitions, access rights, reporting rhythms and decision needs across Reform UK, identifying duplication, gaps and areas where information is currently fragmented.</li> <li>Design and implement a practical data stack that can bring together appropriate information from digital channels, website, search, email, ReformGo, membership, campaigns and other organisational systems.</li> <li>Establish clear definitions, baselines, targets and data-quality standards so senior leaders are not making decisions from conflicting numbers.</li> <li>Create a roadmap that moves the organisation from isolated reports and manual extracts towards trusted, timely and increasingly automated decision support.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build dashboards that drive decisions</strong></p> <p>Create intuitive dashboards and scorecards for senior leadership and operational teams, focused on decisions rather than data for its own sake.</p> <p>Develop role-appropriate views so executives can see the organisation-wide picture while teams can drill into the detail they need to manage performance day to day.</p> <p>Connect output and activity to outcomes wherever attribution is reasonable, helping teams understand movement from attention to owned relationship, repeat behaviour, membership, participation or other useful actions.</p> <p>Automate recurring reporting and data preparation where practical, reducing manual effort and increasing the frequency and reliability of insight.</p> <p>Ensure dashboards show trends, targets and context rather than isolated totals that can easily mislead.</p> <p><strong>Turn raw data into insight and action</strong></p> <p>Produce concise, decision-ready analysis that explains what changed, why it matters, what is likely driving it and what the organisation should do next.</p> <p>Identify where audiences, members or supporters stop progressing through journeys and work with relevant teams to test improvements.</p> <p>Create a disciplined test-and-learn framework with hypotheses, success criteria and post-test analysis so the organisation learns systematically rather than anecdotally.</p> <p>Use segmentation and cohort analysis to uncover meaningful patterns in behaviour.</p> <p><strong>Embed data-driven decision-making across Reform UK</strong></p> <p>Work with the Executive Editor, Director of Operations and other senior stakeholders to establish regular performance and insight reviews that lead to impactful decisions.</p> <p>Support Website, Video, Social, Communications, Campaigns, Membership, Operations and other teams with practical analysis, helping each function understand its own performance in the wider system.</p> <p>Challenge weak assumptions and vanity metrics constructively, distinguishing signal from noise and making clear where the evidence is incomplete or attribution is uncertain.</p> <p>Train colleagues to understand the dashboards and core metrics so data literacy increases throughout the organisation rather than becoming dependent on one analyst.</p> <p><strong>Own governance, compliance and trust</strong></p> <p>Be the internal expert on data governance for the analytics function, ensuring work aligns with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act, ICO guidance and relevant organisational policies.</p> <p>Work closely with the DPO and system owners on lawful basis, consent, minimisation, retention, access, pseudonymisation, URL/log hygiene and appropriate use of personal data.</p> <p>Maintain clear data lineage, permissions and documentation so key metrics are reproducible and sensitive information is available only to those who genuinely need it.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Performance and Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build alerting and monitoring for material changes, broken journeys, unusual movements or data-quality failures where rapid intervention is valuable.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, digital teams, campaigns, membership, operations, suppliers and technical partners so the data function is seen as an enabler rather than a reporting bottleneck.</li> <li>Communicate complex analysis in clear, plain English, surface new ideas and be confident presenting findings to senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Manage external analytics, BI, data or technology suppliers where required, ensuring integrations, costs and deliverables are properly controlled.</li> <li>Maintain political awareness and discretion when working with sensitive organisational, membership or campaign data and understand that some insights will be operationally or reputationally sensitive.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>THE PERSON</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a senior data and analytics expert who has built practical insight capability before and can turn fragmented information into a trusted system that improves decisions.</p> <p><strong>Essential experience and capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>A proven track record of establishing or materially improving a data, analytics, BI or insight operation in a complex organisation.</li> <li>Strong experience integrating disparate data sources and designing a practical reporting architecture rather than relying on disconnected manual reports.</li> <li>Demonstrable ability to build dashboards that colleagues actually use, with clear metrics, trends, context, drill-downs and decision relevance.</li> <li>Excellent analytical judgement: able to distinguish signal from noise, explain uncertainty, avoid misleading attribution and turn numbers into actionable insight.</li> <li>Strong technical competence with relevant data, analytics and BI tools, including the ability to work effectively with APIs, structured data, automation and modern dashboarding platforms.</li> <li>Experience defining KPIs, baselines, targets, cohorts and measurement frameworks across multiple functions or stages of a user/member journey.</li> <li>Outstanding communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical senior stakeholders and influence decisions without hiding behind jargon.</li> <li>Expert understanding of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act, ICO guidance, consent, minimisation, retention, access controls and good data-governance practice.</li> <li>Highly organised, self-sufficient and able to manage multiple stakeholders, systems, dependencies and priorities while maintaining clear documentation and data trust.</li> <li>Proactive and pragmatic: willing to build a useful first version quickly, automate what matters and improve iteratively rather than waiting for a perfect enterprise architecture.</li> <li>Strong interest in British politics and comfort handling sensitive information within a high-profile, mission-led political organisation where discretion and judgement are essential.</li> <li>Willingness to work full-time from Reform UK's Westminster HQ and flex around major political, font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Required Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in leading complex integration and development programmes&nbsp;</li> <li>Solid Software Engineering principles and best-practices</li> <li>Knowledge of Software Engineering standards (civilian/automotive/defence)&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of multi-stage Validation &amp; We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications—ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. description: Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution About us: We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you? We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. Role Purpose Reporting to the Group Chief People Officer and sitting on the People Leadership Team, the Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution plays a central role in shaping how the function operates and delivers. They turn ClearBank’s People strategy into a focused plan and drive delivery through the People Leadership Team and programme owners. They connect priorities, programmes, budgets and governance - creating clarity, strengthening accountability and ensuring decisions lead to action and measurable outcomes. The role gives a clear view of progress, risks and investment choices, while coordinating high-quality reporting for Group ExCo, Board and TopCo. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with broad exposure across ClearBank. When priorities stall or complex challenges arise, they step in to unblock progress, bring structure and pace, and lead critical programmes that matter to the business Key Responsibilities Own the People strategy and roadmap, partnering with the Group Chief People Officer and People Leadership Team to translate business priorities into clear outcomes, choices and plans. Drive execution of the People roadmap through People leaders and programme owners, maintaining oversight of progress, outcomes, risks and dependencies; providing constructive challenge; resolving cross-functional blockers; and escalating issues and decisions to keep delivery on track. Lead executive and Board reporting, producing clear, commercially focused insight and recommendations for Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums. Lead selected high-priority People initiatives, bringing structure, pace and stakeholder alignment to complex work requiring additional focus or acceleration. Own People Team operations and governance, running effective forums, agendas, decisions, actions and escalations, and ensuring clear ownership and follow-through. Own the People budget and Finance partnership, overseeing planning, forecasting, expenditure and investment choices to align resources with priorities and optimise costs. Build portfolio and programme capability across the People function, putting in place proportionate standards, tools and ways of working that improve delivery, alongside clear management information on outcomes, costs, risks, dependencies, capacity and decisions required. Improve how the People function operates, using clearer standards, simpler processes, data, digital tools and AI to strengthen consistency, insight and effectiveness. What success looks like in the role: The People strategy is clearly articulated, understood and translated into a prioritised roadmap with ClearBank’s People strategy is translated into action and delivers measurable outcomes. The Group Chief People Officer has a clear, reliable view of what is being delivered, by when, and where progress is at risk. The People Leadership Team is aligned around the roadmap, decisions, ownership and delivery expectations. Capacity constraints and competing demands are visible early, with clear recommendations on priorities, sequencing and trade-offs. Issues and dependencies are surfaced and resolved quickly, keeping critical work on track. The People function operates effectively and consistently, with proportionate governance, clear accountability and strong follow-through. The People function is represented credibly and commercially through high-quality reporting to Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums. Skills & Experience (must-have) Significant experience translating functional or business strategy into prioritised roadmaps and measurable outcomes. raw.title: Associate Director,  People Strategy & Execution
raw.description:
Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution

About us:

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

Role Purpose

Reporting to the Group Chief People Officer and sitting on the People Leadership Team, the Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution plays a central role in shaping how the function operates and delivers.

They turn ClearBank’s People strategy into a focused plan and drive delivery through the People Leadership Team and programme owners. They connect priorities, programmes, budgets and governance - creating clarity, strengthening accountability and ensuring decisions lead to action and measurable outcomes. The role gives a clear view of progress, risks and investment choices, while coordinating high-quality reporting for Group ExCo, Board and TopCo.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role with broad exposure across ClearBank. When priorities stall or complex challenges arise, they step in to unblock progress, bring structure and pace, and lead critical programmes that matter to the business

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the People strategy and roadmap, partnering with the Group Chief People Officer and People Leadership Team to translate business priorities into clear outcomes, choices and plans.

  • Drive execution of the People roadmap through People leaders and programme owners, maintaining oversight of progress, outcomes, risks and dependencies; providing constructive challenge; resolving cross-functional blockers; and escalating issues and decisions to keep delivery on track.

  • Lead executive and Board reporting, producing clear, commercially focused insight and recommendations for Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums.

  • Lead selected high-priority People initiatives, bringing structure, pace and stakeholder alignment to complex work requiring additional focus or acceleration.

  • Own People Team operations and governance, running effective forums, agendas, decisions, actions and escalations, and ensuring clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Own the People budget and Finance partnership, overseeing planning, forecasting, expenditure and investment choices to align resources with priorities and optimise costs.

  • Build portfolio and programme capability across the People function, putting in place proportionate standards, tools and ways of working that improve delivery, alongside clear management information on outcomes, costs, risks, dependencies, capacity and decisions required.

  • Improve how the People function operates, using clearer standards, simpler processes, data, digital tools and AI to strengthen consistency, insight and effectiveness.

What success looks like in the role:

  • The People strategy is clearly articulated, understood and translated into a prioritised roadmap with

  • ClearBank’s People strategy is translated into action and delivers measurable outcomes.

  • The Group Chief People Officer has a clear, reliable view of what is being delivered, by when, and where progress is at risk.

  • The People Leadership Team is aligned around the roadmap, decisions, ownership and delivery expectations.

  • Capacity constraints and competing demands are visible early, with clear recommendations on priorities, sequencing and trade-offs.

  • Issues and dependencies are surfaced and resolved quickly, keeping critical work on track.

  • The People function operates effectively and consistently, with proportionate governance, clear accountability and strong follow-through.

  • The People function is represented credibly and commercially through high-quality reporting to Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums.

Skills & Experience (must-have)

  • Significant experience translating functional or business strategy into prioritised roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong programme or portfolio leadership experience, driving delivery through others using proportionate, adaptable approaches.

  • Experience building effective governance and operating rhythms across senior leadership teams and complex portfolios.

  • Excellent analytical, written and visual communication skills, turning complex information into concise, high-quality papers, presentations and recommendations for executive and Board audiences.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.

  • Credibility and influence with senior leaders, with the judgement to challenge constructively, align stakeholders and embed decisions without formal authority.

  • A pragmatic, solutions-focused track record of simplifying complexity and improving execution, using proportionate standards, adaptable tools, data and AI to improve insight and delivery without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Nice-to-have

  • Working within, or in close partnership with, a People or HR function.

  • Experience in banking, fintech, financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Supporting Group ExCo, Board, or investor governance forums.

  • Experience operating across multiple countries, legal entities or a matrix organisational structure.

  • Familiarity with OKRs or comparable strategy execution methodologies.

Ways of Working & Culture

  • Build trust together: Own outcomes end to end, follow through on commitments and create transparency around progress, risks and decisions.

  • Care like we mean it: Consider the impact of strategic and operational decisions on colleagues, clients and the organisation, while providing direct and respectful challenge.

  • Grow with the challenge: Remain resilient in a fast-moving environment, simplify complexity and use feedback and evidence to continually improve plans and delivery.

  • Succeed as one: Engage stakeholders early, bring teams together around shared priorities and put organisation-wide outcomes ahead of functional boundaries.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge legacy approaches, convert ideas into practical action and build governance and delivery solutions that can scale.

If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

 

*Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

As our first Customer Success Engineer in EMEA, you’ll help shape the team and make sure our most complex customers are built to scale, not just set up for go-live.

What that looks like day to day

Our Customer Success team is at the heart of incident.io. We understand customer challenges and deliver Incident Management solutions that make a real impact.

We take a customer-led approach, working closely with Product to understand and address each customer’s unique challenges. We go beyond satisfaction, aiming to delight customers at every stage and build long-term relationships based on trust, shared success, and mutual growth.

As leading organizations come to rely on incident.io, you’ll guide governance, scalable configuration, and long-term architecture so their incident management programs scale reliably across teams, not just at go-live. Who you are

The senior medical writer will partner cross-functionally with client teams in Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory, and Program Management in leading the planning and preparation of high-quality clinical regulatory documents. The medical writer may produce protocols, publications, study reports, investigator brochures, narratives, and module documents, according to client and agency guidelines, to support drug development under brisk timelines. 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the execution of documents, including project management tasks such as creating, maintaining, and communicating timelines 

  • Coordinate cross-functional client contributors and stakeholders as well as internal resources (e.g., quality control [QC], publishing) to ensure timely completion of documents 

  • Ensure document development adheres to any relevant client processes, templates, and instructional documents 

  • Serve as an expert on client document management system and related tools, templates, and procedures to ensure efficient document development  

  • Lead document message development in collaboration with client  

  • Interpret data and create shell documents to support authoring 

  • Plan and lead kickoff meetings  

  • Facilitate resolution of review feedback including planning and leading comment resolution meetings (curate review comments to ensure meetings are efficient)  

  • Follow-up with individual team members as needed to resolve outstanding review feedback 

  • Ensure consistency among client programs in terms of messaging, formatting, and presentation of documents  

  • Conduct literature searches as needed 

  • Perform peer QC review as needed  

  • Contribute to medical writing operational initiatives (e.g., templates, style guides, reference management), if needed 


  • Experience (5+ years) as a medical writer in the CRO/biotech/pharmaceutical field  

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field  

  • Oncology, Infectious Disease, or Vaccine experience desired 

  • Experience desired in writing clinical study reports, protocols, protocol amendments, investigator brochures, module 2, and module 5 documents 

  • Flexibility to work across multiple therapeutic areas, if needed 

  • Experience writing documents according to established processes and document templates 

  • Familiarity with lean authoring approaches and structured content management 

  • Familiarity with the requirements for preparation of key clinical and regulatory documents, including ICH and US regulatory requirements; working knowledge of ex-US regulatory requirements is desired  

  • Expertise with Microsoft Word and other Microsoft applications  

  • Experience developing documents using document management systems, collaborative authoring tools, and review tools 

  • Comfortable adapting to new tools and technologies, if needed 

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in the face of competing priorities  

  • Service-oriented and proactive approach to project management  

  • Excellent conflict management and negotiation skills  

  • Comfortable providing suggestions based on previous experience 

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

TransPerfect provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law

(NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.</p> <h4>About the job</h4> <p>OpenTable helps restaurants turn guests into regulars and the Hospitality team is where that promise is designed. As Principal Product Designer, you will own the design vision for how restaurants communicate with their guests, using AI to speed the process without sacrificing a personal touch. dental insurance</li> <li>Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year</li> <li>Focus on mental health and well-being:</li> <ul> <li>Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth</li> <li>Company-paid subscription to Headspace</li> <li>Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)</li> </ul> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Time off for your birthday</li> <li>Paid volunteer time</li> <li>Focus on your career growth:</li> <ul> <li>Development Dollars</li> <li>Leadership development</li> <li>Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings</li> </ul> <li>Travel Discounts</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups</li> <li>Income protection and life assurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP &amp; free legal advice</li> <li>Pension plan contributions</li> <li>Discounted gym membership</li> <li>Bike2Work</li> <li>Season ticket loan</li> <li>Social events &amp; Thursday happy hours</li> <li>Free lunch 2 days per week</li> </ul> <p>The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.</p> <p><strong>Work Environment &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <p>At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. You will support triage of incoming requests, making sure client needs and timelines are clearly passed to the right Kraken teams. You will use key tools (Slack, Asana) to manage tasks, document progress and report effectively. You will identify potential risks to client outcomes and take proactive steps to address them, escalating early when you need support. You will actively contribute to team rituals and share what you learn, helping to keep momentum going. You will be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech, based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage expectations and give clear updates to clients and colleagues. Good problem-solving skills and the ability to break down a complex problem into clear next steps. The ability to work independently and take initiative, with a strong focus on getting things done, and the judgement to know when to ask for help. A proactive, adaptable and hands-on mindset, willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem. Resilience and empathy, staying positive and persistent through challenges while understanding the human impact of change on the people we work with. A real appetite to learn, give and receive feedback, and grow quickly. We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open-minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever-changing environment. ⭐ Bonus points Exposure to consulting, project delivery or technology implementations. Experience using data to investigate problems (e.g. SQL, spreadsheets or BI tools). For this particular role, prior experience in the energy sector is strongly preferred. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, values teamwork and growth, and is eager to make a tangible impact on client success. This role provides the foundation to learn about technical delivery and provides an opportunity to become an expert in a technical domain. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at ----- We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. description: <h2>🧡 About Alma</h2> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place — serving merchants and consumers.</p> <p>Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience — without encouraging bad debt.</p> <p>As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.</p> <p>With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR in 2025, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <h2>👐 About the team</h2> <p>Alma is a lender. We originate several million consumer receivables a year, carry them for a few weeks, and refinance them off a deliberately light balance sheet through securitization vehicles (Fonds Communs de Titrisation) and our other funding lines. We are regulated as a société de financement and a payment institution.</p> <p>That changes what "accounting" means here. A lender's accounts are not a monthly deliverable produced at the end of a chain: <strong>they are the chain</strong>. Every payment event, every commission, every provision, every sale of receivables to an FCT has to become a journal entry that ties — to the transaction underneath it, to the general ledger above it, and to the prudential statements the regulator reads. At our scale and growth, this is a strategic topic, and one that is as much about data as it is about accounting.</p> <p>Today the chain exists: an internal core banking ledger we built ourselves, feeding NetSuite, feeding regulatory reporting. What it does not have is a single owner who understands it end-to-end, holds it to the standard a regulated lender needs, and evolves it as the business changes (geographies, products, licenses). That is the role we are opening.</p> <p>You will join an Accounting team inside a Finance organization of ~15 people covering Strategic Financing, FP&amp;A, Accounting, Regulatory reporting and Controlling. You will report to the Head of Financing &amp; Accounting, alongside the Financing team and the General Accounting Manager, who oversees corporate cycles, tax, statutory and consolidated accounts.</p> <p>This is a role with unusual ownership for its level: the banking accounting scope is yours from day one, and so is the data chain that produces it.</p> <h2>💼 About the job</h2> <p><strong>Own the accounting of the credit business:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own how the portfolio is represented in the books: origination, revenue recognition on merchant and customer commissions, deferred income, write-offs and recoveries, cost of risk and provisioning on performing and non-performing exposures.</li> <li>Own the accounting of our securitizations: sales of receivables to the FCTs, derecognition, discount and over-collateralisation, residual interests, servicing and management fees, hedging.</li> <li>Own the accounting of our funding: corporate debt, commercial paper, and the new funding instruments we add as the refinancing strategy evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the core banking ledger:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the functional owner of the engine that turns business events into accounting: which event, which account, which currency, which date, which counterparty.</li> <li>Specify and validate the accounting schemes for every new product, partner and geography, and work with Engineering and Data on the ledger's model, its feed into the ERP, and the fixes when something drifts.</li> <li>Own the audit trail end-to-end — from a single €40 installment to a line in a prudential statement — and make it documented enough to be walked through by someone whose job is to challenge it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reinforce the control framework:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and automate the reconciliations that hold the whole thing together: ledger ↔ general ledger ↔ bank ↔ FCT reporting ↔ prudential statements.</li> <li>Shorten monthly close, incl. turning a manual, end-of-month, spreadsheet-based check into an automated, evidenced, repeatable control.</li> <li>Be Finance's counterpart to Internal Control and Periodic Control on everything accounting-data related.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own regulatory reporting:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the production and the quality of our prudential and statistical reporting — solvency, large exposures, liquidity, and the statistical returns that go with them.</li> <li>Own the reconciliation tables that matter most: prudential statements to accounting balances, regulatory returns to the trial balance, own funds and RWA back to their audit trail.</li> <li>Own the reporting tooling and its data feeds, and work with the Regulatory and Financing teams on the evolutions of the prudential framework and on the treatment of our securitizations.</li> </ul> <h2>🧩 About you</h2> <p><strong>To succeed in this job:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have around 6-7 years of experience, ideally starting in audit of financial services — banks, consumer credit, asset management, securitization — in a Big 4 or a specialised practice, possibly with a first move in-house. You know how to build a number, prove it, and defend it line by line in front of people whose job is to challenge it.</li> <li>You know banking accounting for real: French banking GAAP, the PCEC, cost of risk, revenue recognition on credit products. Or you know financial services accounting well enough that the banking layer is a matter of months, not years.</li> <li>You actually enjoy controls at scale — reconciling large populations, hunting the anomaly, chasing the last twelve euros of a four-hundred-million balance until you know exactly where they went. If that sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this is not your role.</li> <li>You are autonomous and scrappy. On things to build, or on things that already exist.</li> <li>You are fluent in English and French — our documentation and our regulator are French, part of our business and our team are not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>And it will be nice if you also:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold, or are working towards, the DEC (or CPA, ACCA, equivalent).</li> <li>Have been exposed to securitization — FCTs, SPVs, waterfalls, deconsolidation — or to a regulated credit institution from the inside.</li> <li><strong>You are autonomous on data.</strong> SQL is a daily tool, a data warehouse does not intimidate you, and your reflex in front of a five-million-row population is to query it, not to ask someone for a summary. This is the single most important line in this job description.</li> <li>Know NetSuite, BigQuery, dbt or Python.</li> <li>Have worked in a scaling fintech.</li> </ul> <p>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</p> <h2>🤑 Compensation &amp; Benefits</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary based on 12 months</li> <li>Profit-sharing and employee savings plan</li> <li>Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package</li> <li>Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma</li> <li>Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li>Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li>Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)</li> <li>Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li>Mental health: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li>Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li>Access to our Learning &amp; Development Platform</li> <li>2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer</li> </ul> <h2>🎯 Interview Process</h2> <ul> <li>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation &amp; present you the role.</li> <li>Video call with Thibaut Mercier, Head of Financing, Regulatory Capital Optimization &amp; Accounting</li> <li>Business case</li> <li>Video call with Stephanie Combe, CFO</li> </ul> <h2>🌍 Diversity &amp; Inclusion</h2> <p>At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
